faq.q: Can I support the project financially?
faq.a: Yes, and support is entirely optional. The details are on the "Support us" page.

faq.q: What license is the code under?
faq.a: The website's code is released under the MIT License. The license covers the code only; the name «Dar Islam & Technology», its logo and the site's content are not included. Each product has its own explicit license, stated in its repository.

faq.q: Do I need write access to the main repository?
faq.a: No. Contributions go through forks and pull requests, and maintainers review changes before merging.

faq.q: How do I report a security issue?
faq.a: Privately, never in a public issue: use Report a vulnerability in the repository's Security tab, or email the project address. The details are in SECURITY.md.

about.title: A home for Islamic knowledge, da'wah and technology
about.description: Get to know Dar Islam & Technology: who we are, why we started and where we are heading.
about.who: Dar Islam & Technology is an educational and da'wah platform that strives to prepare scholars and callers with da'wah projects of their own, and programmers and technologists who build tech projects that serve Islam, while offering cultural, awareness and beneficial entertainment content.
about.nameBody: "Dar Islam & Technology" sums up our mission: bringing Islamic knowledge and modern technology together in useful content and products.
about.mission: To teach Muslims what they must know of their religion and every person what they must know of technology, to spread awareness and da'wah through beneficial content, and to build tech tools and projects that serve Islam and make people's lives easier.
about.vision: A generation of scholars and callers with da'wah projects of their own, and of programmers and technologists who serve Islam with beneficial tech projects and take part in shaping the future rather than only consuming its technology.
about.ambition: A community of Islamic studies specialists, callers, programmers and creators working together on beneficial da'wah and tech projects that serve Islam and Muslims and benefit every person.
about.roadmapTitle: Building step by step, in the open
about.roadmapBody: We are now in the build phase: the site is live, and we are working on our first products and learning tracks. We never claim a product before it launches, and we share our progress as it is.
values: The scientific and technical revival of the Muslim community
about.communityBody: Dar Islam & Technology started as a one-person effort, and the ambition is a community where Islamic studies specialists, callers and technologists build world-class solutions together.
about.founderBio: Marwan works in Saudi Arabia in web development and search engine optimization (SEO). He is a student of Islamic sciences at Zad Academy, with a keen interest in da'wah and technology.
